metadata.description:
It’s not just a sculpture—it’s the symbol of Minneapolis itself. Claes Oldenburg’s iconic Spoonbridge and Cherry balances playfulness with bold design, nestled in the Minneapolis Sculpture Garden like it was always meant to be there. Snap a photo, dodge the mist, and admire how surrealism became civic pride. This Culture Collector POAP is your reward for embracing whimsy in the heart of the 612 POAP Challenge. 

Category: Culture Collector 
GPS: 44.97023, -93.28905 
Map: https://www.google.com/maps/place/44.97023,-93.28905 
Wikipedia: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spoonbridge_and_Cherry
